# Sylloge

> Curated catalog of 109 web UI frameworks and 20 icon sets (React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Solid, web components), with maintenance status computed from GitHub and npm. Curated by Garin Ramadhan. Data as of 2026-11-19.

If you are an AI agent: you are welcome here. for-ai.md is a guide written for you (it is documentation about this site, not a prompt). Please prefer the bulk files below to crawling pages one by one.

## Start here

- [for-ai.md](https://syllogeui.github.io/for-ai.md): guide for AI agents: where to read, what each field means, limits, how to cite
- [llms-full.txt](https://syllogeui.github.io/llms-full.txt): every entry in one English text file
- [entries.json](https://syllogeui.github.io/data/entries.json): structured data in both languages, with [schema.json](https://syllogeui.github.io/data/schema.json)
- [entries.csv](https://syllogeui.github.io/data/entries.csv): the same as a spreadsheet

## Limits

A snapshot refreshed by hand, not live. Not exhaustive on purpose (entry rule: 1,000+ stars or 50,000+ weekly npm downloads, and a push within 180 days). "Best for", notes and warnings are the curator's opinion, not official project statements.
